Day by day
01
Sat 19 Dec YONGPYEONG

Fly + First Snow

Fly HKG → Incheon (~3.5 hrs), then a van east into the Gangwon mountains (~3 hrs). Check into the ski-in/out condo, collect rental gear and boots, and get an early night before day one on the snow.

HKG ✈ ICNVan to Yongpyeong
02
SKI DAY
Sun 20 Dec YONGPYEONG

Ski Day 1 — Lessons

Group lesson for all three kids on the Mega Green beginner slope while the grown-ups find their feet. Night sledding after dinner — the first real taste of a white Christmas.

Group lessonNight sledding
03
SKI DAY
Mon 21 Dec YONGPYEONG

Ski Day 2 — Free Ski

Second lesson in the morning, free ski in the afternoon. The goal of the day: a first blue run for the 11-year-old, with the younger two lapping the green.

Lesson 2First blue run
04
SKI DAY
Tue 22 Dec YONGPYEONG

Ski Day 3 — Family Day

The day it clicks: whole family on the slopes together. Tubing in the afternoon, then a long hot bath back at the condo with the floor heating on.

TubingHot bath
05
Wed 23 Dec SEOUL

Ski → Seoul

Optional fourth ski morning (9am–12pm, +HK$4,000 — decide on the day). Van to Seoul (~3 hrs), check into the Myeongdong suite, then dinner in the lanes below.

Van to SeoulMyeongdong dinner
06
CHRISTMAS
Thu 24 Dec SEOUL

Christmas Eve

Cable car up to N Seoul Tower for the lights, Santa Village, and the Lantern Festival along the stream. Hot chocolate and street snacks on the way home.

N Seoul TowerLantern Festival
07
CHRISTMAS
Fri 25 Dec SEOUL

Christmas Day

Hanbok rental and a morning at Gyeongbokgung Palace, then Lotte World for the Christmas show and parade. Slow dinner back at the suite.

Hanbok at PalaceLotte World parade
08
Sat 26 Dec DEPARTURE

Fly Home

Slow breakfast, a last wander through Namdaemun Market for socks and souvenirs, then the airport train to Incheon and home.

Namdaemun MarketICN ✈ HKG

Ski first while legs are fresh, then relax into Christmas in Seoul. Three days on the snow is the sweet spot for first-timers, and both stays have a kitchen and space for five — no two-room split, no cold hotel corridors.
